title: sprint-003 in progress — Malta market analysis + 100-provider acquisition plan
summary: Competitor map complete. First-100 provider plan defined: 3 phases, €700-800 total budget, CAC €10 blended.
details: COMPETITOR MAP: FB groups = 95% of local service transactions (no structured platform). Bark.com Malta: stale, <50 providers. Task.com.mt: static listings, no booking flow. Platform is unopposed in AI-backed, escrow-verified, rating-ranked segment. 100-PROVIDER PLAN: Phase 1 (1-30): direct FB/WhatsApp outreach, 0% commission first 30 days. Phase 2 (31-70): referral program, unique link, €5 credit per referred provider completing 3 orders. Phase 3 (71-100): Meta ads €300 total (€150 FB + €150 IG), targeting self-employed service workers Malta. NEXT DELIVERABLES: referral program spec + CAC tracker. sprint-008 (Sicily/Barcelona) gated until sprint-003 reaches 50 providers.
